title: Read every board in order
prompt: Source is supplied. Write public static async Task<List<int>> CountsAsync(List<string> boards). Read each board in order and return the counts in the same order. When a board is offline, put -1 in its place and carry on with the next board.
hints: If the second of three boards fails, how many numbers must the result have?
Each read needs its own try and catch, so one failure does not end the loop.
Inside the loop, await the count in a try and add it. In the catch for InvalidOperationException, add -1.
checkLabels: desk then lab must give 3 then 5.
An offline board in the middle must give -1 there, and the boards after it must still be read.
No boards must give an empty list.
A single offline board must give a list with -1.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Wraps the whole loop in one try, so the first failure ends the reading.
Leaves a failed board out instead of marking it with -1.

feedback: Count the numbers in your result for three boards where the middle one is offline. There must be three, with -1 in the middle.
